caption:
Big task? Don't ask AI for everything at once. 🧠

Try: "I need to [goal]. First give me a step-by-step plan only. Wait for me to say go before doing step 1."
Then work through it one step at a time.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #productivity #workflow #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Asking AI for everything at once gives messy results.
scenes.say: Asking AI for everything at once gives messy results. Ask for a plan first.

scenes.title: Plan first, then go
scenes.user: I need to launch a newsletter. Give me a step-by-step plan only. Wait for my go.
scenes.reply:
Plan:
1. Pick your topic and audience
2. Choose a free email tool
3. Draft your first issue
Say go for step 1.
scenes.say: Try this. I need to launch a newsletter. Give me a step by step plan only, and wait for my go. The AI lists the steps and waits for you.

scenes.title: Work in small pieces
items: Fix any step you disagree with
Say go, one step at a time
scenes.say: Three steps. Ask for the plan only. Fix any step you disagree with. Then say go, one step at a time.
All at once is long, vague, and hard to fix. Plan first gives you clear steps you control.
